args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback verified as rolled out successfully. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed without identifying and fixing the root cause of the health check failures.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Reviewing the deployment history, v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent version that had been healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all three production regions. The rollback was verified as successfully rolled out.
3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, documenting the health check failures on v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause is identified. The on-call engineer has been paged.
